scope: Four author-visible synthetic closed-domain tasks; manual gold, not a hidden set or general prose-quality judge

tasks.goal: Prepare the current release decision for Cedar. Resolve superseded draft information using the approved update and count only OPEN blockers.

report.txt: Project: Cedar. This document is draft v1, superseded by approved v2 in supplement.txt.
Draft release date: 2026-10-09. Draft release owner: Niko.
Blocker ledger: B-11 OPEN; B-12 CLOSED; B-13 CLOSED. Only OPEN items prevent release.
supplement.txt: U1
Approved release v2 for Cedar supersedes draft v1: release date 2026-10-12; release owner Mira.
U2
Release decision rule: one or more OPEN blockers means blocked; zero means ready.

decision.description: String blocked or ready under the given rule

tasks.goal: Summarize the actual Beacon production incident, separating a dry-run from the real event. Report duration, affected customers, and only a confirmed root cause.

report.txt: All timestamps are UTC on 2026-10-03. Beacon dry-run simulation: 09:00 start; 09:45 end; no production impact.
Beacon production impact began at 10:04. Production service was fully restored at 10:21.
An early dashboard suggested 9 affected customers; this estimate is superseded by the final impact review.
supplement.txt: F1
Final production impact review: 3 distinct customers affected. The number 9 counted retries, not customers.
F2
Root cause is unconfirmed. A cache issue is a hypothesis only; report null for confirmed root cause.

duration_minutes.description: Integer duration of actual production impact, excluding dry-run

affected_customers.description: Final distinct customer count as integer

confirmed_root_cause.description: Confirmed cause string, or JSON null when unconfirmed

restored_at_utc.description: Time of actual production restoration as HH:MM string

tasks.goal: Compute saleable unreserved PINE inventory at North warehouse, excluding pending receipts and quarantined/reserved stock; apply the reorder rule.

supplement.txt: Q1
For North/PINE, 6 on-hand units are quarantined and 20 other on-hand units are reserved. These sets do not overlap.
Q2
Available = confirmed North/PINE opening stock + received North/PINE receipts - quarantined units - reserved units. Pending receipts and South stock are excluded.
Q3
Reorder when available units are strictly below 30; otherwise do not reorder.

available_units.description: Saleable unreserved North/PINE units as integer

pending_units_excluded.description: North/PINE pending receipt units excluded as integer

reorder.description: JSON boolean under the reorder rule

warehouse.description: Warehouse named in the applicable calculation rule

tasks.goal: Reconcile approved synthetic project expenses in USD cents. Exclude pending items, apply an approved credit as negative cost, and test the approved budget.

report.txt: All amounts below are integer USD cents for project Harbor; there are no taxes or currency conversions.
Invoice D: 9000 cents; PENDING, not approved.
supplement.txt: B1
Credit C against invoice A: 2000 cents; APPROVED. Subtract this credit once from approved expenses.
B2
Harbor approved budget: 20000 USD cents. Net approved cost includes approved invoices less approved credits; exclude PENDING items.
B3
Within budget means net approved cost is less than or equal to approved budget; remaining = budget - net approved cost.

net_approved_cents.description: Net approved cost in integer USD cents

remaining_cents.description: Remaining budget in integer USD cents

within_budget.description: JSON boolean under the given budget rule

pending_cents_excluded.description: Excluded pending amount as integer USD cents
